brief:
Israel's national football team wore black armbands during their Nations League match against Ireland on Sunday to commemorate victims of Hamas' October 7, 2023 attack, Al-Monitor reported. The gesture came after Irish players had worn armbands to protest the war in Gaza.

Both teams used the black armband at the fixture, each signaling a different message about the conflict and its toll.
dek: Israel's national football team wore black armbands in their Nations League clash against Ireland on Sunday to commemorate the victims of Hamas' October 7, 2023 attack, after Irish players wore them to protest the war in Gaza.
title: Israeli footballers wear black armbands against Ireland in Nations League
